verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for an agent-workflow skills bundle, but nothing in the evidence documents a cron, timer, or recurring-run capability. The material covers one-off slash-command skills: TDD, grilling, and triage, including labeling work 'ready-for-agent' for an AFK agent. Plugin auto-updates at startup are an install behavior, not a user-defined schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
